items.description: This section provides a curated list of training materials, documentation, and educational resources for those interested in learning about web archiving practices, methodologies, and tools.

children.title: A Whirlwind Tour of Common Crawl's Datasets using Python
A Whirlwind Tour of Common Crawl's Datasets as a Python notebook
A Whirlwind Tour of Common Crawl's Datasets using Java

items.title: Training/Documentation

items.description: This list of tools and software is intended to briefly describe some of the most important and widely-used tools related to web archiving. For more details, we recommend you refer to (and contribute to!) these excellent resources from other groups:

children.title: ArchiveBox
children.description: A tool which maintains an additive archive from RSS feeds, bookmarks, and links using wget, Chrome headless, and other methods (formerly ). (In Development)

children.title: SingleFile
children.description: Browser extension for Firefox/Chrome and CLI tool to save a faithful copy of a complete page as a single HTML file. (Stable)

children.title: monolith
children.description: CLI tool to save a web page as a single HTML file. (Stable)

children.title: DiskerNet
children.description: A non-WARC-based tool which hooks into the Chrome browser and archives everything you browse making it available for offline replay. (In Development)

children.title: Heritrix
children.description: An open source, extensible, web-scale, archival quality web crawler. (Stable)

children.title: Heritrix Q&A
children.description: A discussion forum for asking questions and getting answers about using Heritrix.

children.title: Heritrix Walkthrough
children.description: (In Development)

children.title: Wayback
children.description: A toolkit for snapshot webpage to Internet Archive, archive.today, IPFS and beyond. (Stable)

children.title: grab-site
children.description: The archivist's web crawler: WARC output, dashboard for all crawls, dynamic ignore patterns. (Stable)

children.title: twarc
children.description: A command line tool and Python library for archiving Twitter JSON data. (Stable)

children.title: Browsertrix Crawler
children.description: A Chromium based high-fidelity crawling system, designed to run a complex, customizable browser-based crawl in a single Docker container. (Stable)

children.title: Auto Archiver
children.description: Python script to automatically archive social media posts, videos, and images from a Google Sheets document. Read the article about Auto Archiver on bellingcat.com.

children.title: Brozzler
children.description: A distributed web crawler (爬虫) that uses a real browser (Chrome or Chromium) to fetch pages and embedded urls and to extract links. (Stable)

children.title: Wpull
children.description: A Wget-compatible (or remake/clone/replacement/alternative) web downloader and crawler. (Stable)

children.title: Waybackpy
children.description: Wayback Machine Save, CDX and availability API interface in Python and a command-line tool (Stable)

children.title: Warcprox
children.description: WARC-writing MITM HTTP/S proxy. (Stable)

children.title: archivenow
children.description: A Python library to push web resources into on-demand web archives. (Stable)

children.title: WAIL
children.description: A graphical user interface (GUI) atop multiple web archiving tools intended to be used as an easy way for anyone to preserve and replay web pages; Python, Electron. (Stable)

children.title: Obelisk
children.description: Go package and CLI tool for saving web page as single HTML file. (Stable)

children.title: freeze-dry
children.description: JavaScript library to turn page into static, self-contained HTML document; useful for browser extensions. (In Development)

children.title: Scoop
children.description: High-fidelity, browser-based, single-page web archiving library and CLI for witnessing the web. (Stable)

children.title: Squidwarc
children.description: An open source, high-fidelity, page interacting archival crawler that uses Chrome or Chrome Headless directly. (In Development)

children.title: Chronicler
children.description: Web browser with record and replay functionality. (In Development)

children.title: F(b)arc
children.description: A commandline tool and Python library for archiving data from Facebook using the Graph API. (Stable)

children.title: crau
children.description: A lightweight command-line tool for archiving the Web and playing archives: you just need a list of URLs. The name "crau" stems from the Brazilian pronounciation of "crawl". (Stable)

children.title: Warcworker
children.description: An open source, dockerized, queued, high fidelity web archiver based on Squidwarc with a simple web GUI. (Stable)

children.title: Cairn
children.description: A npm package and CLI tool for saving webpages. (Stable)

children.title: crocoite
children.description: Crawl websites using headless Google Chrome/Chromium and save resources, static DOM snapshot and page screenshots to WARC files. (In Development)

children.title: Web2Warc
children.description: An easy-to-use and highly customizable crawler that enables anyone to create their own little Web archives (WARC/CDX). (Stable)

children.title: html2warc
children.description: A simple script to convert offline data into a single WARC file. (Stable)

children.title: Wget-lua
children.description: Wget with Lua extension. (Stable)

children.title: PYWB
children.description: A Python 3 implementation of web archival replay tools, sometimes also known as 'Wayback Machine'. (Stable)

children.title: InterPlanetary Wayback (ipwb)
children.description: Web Archive (WARC) indexing and replay using IPFS.

children.title: OpenWayback
children.description: The open source project aimed to develop Wayback Machine, the key software used by web archives worldwide to play back archived websites in the user's browser. (Stable)

children.title: warc2html
children.description: Converts WARC files to static HTML suitable for browsing offline or rehosting.

children.title: hyphe
children.description: A webcrawler built for research uses with a graphical user interface in order to build web corpuses made of lists of web actors and maps of links between them. (Stable)

children.title: SolrWayback
children.description: A backend Java and frontend VUE JS project with freetext search and a build in playback engine. Require Warc files has been index with the Warc-Indexer. The web application also has a wide range of data visualization tools and data export tools that can be used on the whole webarchive. SolrWayback 4 Bundle release contains all the software and dependencies in an out-of-the box solution that is easy to install.

children.title: webarchive-discovery
children.description: WARC and ARC full-text indexing and discovery tools, with a number of associated tools capable of using the index shown below. (Stable)

children.title: Other possible options for builting a front-end are listed on in the wiki, here
Mink
children.description: A Google Chrome extension for querying Memento aggregators while browsing and integrating live-archived web navigation. (Stable)

children.title: Warclight
children.description: A Project Blacklight based Rails engine that supports the discovery of web archives held in the WARC and ARC formats. (In Development)

children.title: Shine
children.description: A prototype web archives exploration UI, developed with researchers as part of the Big UK Domain Data for the Arts and Humanities project. (Stable)

children.title: Wasp
children.description: A fully functional prototype of a personal web archive and search system. (In Development)

children.title: PANDORÆ
children.description: A desktop research software to be plugged on a Solr endpoint to query, retrieve, normalize and visually explore web archives. (Stable)

children.title: playback
children.description: A toolkit for searching archived webpages from Internet Archive, archive.today, Memento and beyond. (In Development)

children.title: PastPage
children.description: Browser extension for Chrome and Firefox that recovers broken or changed pages by querying the Wayback Machine and other web archives in parallel. (Stable)

children.title: Go Get Crawl
children.description: Extract web archive data using Wayback Machine and Common Crawl. (Stable)

children.title: ArchiveTools
children.description: Collection of tools to extract and interact with WARC files (Python).

children.title: har2warc
children.description: Convert HTTP Archive (HAR) -> Web Archive (WARC) format (Python).

children.title: duckdb-web-archive-cdx
children.description: DuckDB extension to query the Internet Archive and CommonCrawl CDX APIs directly from SQL. (In Development)

children.title: gowarcserver
children.description: BadgerDB-based capture index (CDX) and WARC record server, used to index and serve WARC files (Go).

children.title: duckdb_warc
children.description: DuckDB extension to query WARC files. (In Development)

children.title: bagnabit2warc
children.description: Convert a bag-nabit dataset stored in a ZIP into a full-content WARC.

children.title: Internet Archive Library
children.description: A command line tool and Python library for interacting directly with archive.org. (Python). (Stable)

children.title: wikiteam
children.description: Tools for downloading and preserving wikis. (Stable)

children.title: warcdb
children.description: A command line utility (Python) for importing WARC files into a SQLite database. (Stable)

children.title: MemGator
children.description: A Memento Aggregator CLI and Server (Golang). (Stable)

children.title: webarchive-indexing
children.description: Tools for bulk indexing of WARC/ARC files on Hadoop, EMR or local file system.

children.title: OutbackCDX
children.description: RocksDB-based capture index (CDX) server supporting incremental updates and compression. Can be used as backend for OpenWayback, PyWb and Heritrix. (Stable)

children.title: httrack2warc
children.description: Convert HTTrack archives to WARC format (Java).

children.title: warcbench
children.description: A tool for exploring, analyzing, transforming, recombining, and extracting data from WARC (Web ARChive) files.

children.title: warc-safe
children.description: Automatic detection of viruses and NSFW content in WARC files.

children.title: py-wasapi-client
children.description: Command line application to download crawls from WASAPI (Python). (Stable)

children.title: MementoMap
children.description: A Tool to Summarize Web Archive Holdings (Python). (In Development)

children.title: tikalinkextract
children.description: Extract hyperlinks as a seed for web archiving from folders of document types that can be parsed by Apache Tika (Golang, Apache Tika Server). (In Development)

children.title: HTTPreserve linkstat
children.description: Command line implementation of httpreserve.info to describe the status of a web page. Can be easily scripted and provides JSON output to enable querying through tools like JQ. HTTPreserve Linkstat describes current status, and earliest and latest links on archive.org. (Golang). (Stable)

children.title: warcrefs
children.description: Web archive deduplication tools. (Stable)

children.title: wasapi-downloader
children.description: Java command line application to download crawls from WASAPI. (Stable)

children.title: node-cdxj
children.description: CDXJ file parser (Node.js). (Stable)

children.title: WarcPartitioner
children.description: Partition (W)ARC Files by MIME Type and Year. (Stable)

children.title: warcio
children.description: Streaming WARC/ARC library for fast web archive IO (Python). (Stable)

children.title: warctools
children.description: Library to work with ARC and WARC files (Python).

children.title: Warcat
children.description: Tool and library for handling Web ARChive (WARC) files (Python). (Stable)

children.title: FastWARC
children.description: A high-performance WARC parsing library (Python).

children.title: node-warc
children.description: Parse WARC files or create WARC files using either Electron or chrome-remote-interface (Node.js). (Stable)

children.title: warc
children.description: A Rust library for reading and writing WARC files. (Stable)

children.title: jwarc
children.description: Read and write WARC files with a type safe API (Java).

children.title: Warcat-rs
children.description: Command-line tool and Rust library for handling Web ARChive (WARC) files. (In Development)

children.title: webarchive
children.description: Golang readers for ARC and WARC webarchive formats (Golang).

children.title: Sparkling
children.description: Internet Archive's Sparkling Data Processing Library. (Stable)

children.title: Unwarcit
children.description: Command line interface to unzip WARC and WACZ files (Python).

children.title: HadoopConcatGz
children.description: A Splitable Hadoop InputFormat for Concatenated GZIP Files (and ). (Stable)

children.title: Jwat-Tools
children.description: Tools for reading/writing/validating WARC/ARC/GZIP files (Java). (Stable)

children.title: Jwat
children.description: Libraries for reading/writing/validating WARC/ARC/GZIP files (Java). (Stable)

children.title: ArchiveSpark
children.description: An Apache Spark framework (not only) for Web Archives that enables easy data processing, extraction as well as derivation. (Stable)

children.title: Archives Unleashed Toolkit
children.description: An open-source platform for analyzing web archives with Apache Spark. (Stable)

children.title: Common Crawl Jupyter notebooks
children.description: A collection of notebooks using Common Crawl's various datasets. (Stable)

children.title: Archives Unleashed Notebooks
children.description: Notebooks for working with web archives with the Archives Unleashed Toolkit, and derivatives generated by the Archives Unleashed Toolkit. (Stable)

children.title: Archives Research Compute Hub
children.description: Web application for distributed compute analysis of Archive-It web archive collections. (Stable)

children.title: Tweet Archvies Unleashed Toolkit
children.description: An open-source toolkit for analyzing line-oriented JSON Twitter archives with Apache Spark. (In Development)

children.title: FlameShot
children.description: Screen capture and annotation on Ubuntu.

children.title: xDoTool
children.description: Click automation on Ubuntu.

children.title: Zotero Robust Links Extension
children.description: A Zotero extension that submits to and reads from web archives. Source on GitHub. Supercedes leonkt/zotero-memento.
